heading: Built after hours.
intro: Small things I make when it's not client work. Some are useful, some are just for fun, all of them taught me something I now use on real projects.

projects.name: Tasbeeh
projects.body: A simple prayer counter that works offline, supports Arabic, remembers your count and gives you a little haptic tap with every click.

projects.name: HeroForge
projects.body: A browser tool for building hero sections by dragging things around, editing text in place and tweaking everything from a properties panel.

projects.name: Rep counter
projects.body: Upload a workout video and it counts your push-ups right in the browser, then exports a clip with the count on screen. Nothing gets uploaded anywhere.

projects.name: Eid card maker
projects.body: Type a name and get a personalised Eid Mubarak video, generated right in your browser. It took five versions to get the browser to cooperate.

projects.name: Calclater
projects.body: A meme page about design, marketing and the internet. It started as a joke and kept going.
